en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing an inner courtyard with historical plaques and reliefs mounted on the walls. There is a decorative arched doorway on the left and several old windows on the upper right. The ground is paved with rectangular stones, and there are a few bicycles leaning against the wall. The setting appears to be a historical or governmental building.
